about: What Carbon costs the Mac, measured. Method and caveats: docs/benchmarks/performance.md. CPU is a percent of one core, as in Activity Monitor.

machine.load: Other apps running: headless Chrome, Orca, Figma. Readings carry about ±0.5 point of noise.

idle.description: Carbon running, waiting for a Meeting to start (Detection on).
idle.carbonVersion: 0.4.0 branch, Debug build running for 2 h after a Meeting (worst case for Carbon)

transcribing.description: A Meeting replayed at real-time pace through Carbon's Recorder: two live SpeechTranscriber sessions (mic and call), audio files, Meeting Language identification. Total = Carbon's process + Apple's localspeechrecognition daemon, which runs the speech model outside Carbon.
